response.title: Today's Intelligence
response.answer: Here are 6 current PTD Today intelligence items available from today's briefing.

bullets.title: Scenario: AI compute clusters may concentrate peak load near data-center substations
bullets.summary: Concentrated AI compute may create localized transformer and substation pressure. Utilities and procurement teams should monitor lead times and contingency sourcing.

bullets.title: Scenario: Critical-minerals availability could constrain transformer manufacturing
bullets.summary: Critical-minerals constraints could slow transformer manufacturing and increase reliance on secondary equipment markets. Procurement strategies should account for material-linked lead-time risk.

bullets.title: Scenario: Growing HVDC converter demand linked to renewable interconnection
bullets.summary: HVDC converter demand may rise with long-distance renewables, creating OEM capacity pressures with knock-on schedule risk for interconnection.

bullets.title: Scenario: Substation automation and AI controls increase cyber risk surface
bullets.summary: Faster substation automation adoption may raise cybersecurity exposure. Investment in security and operational procedures will be critical to realize benefits safely.

bullets.title: Scenario: Tariff and sourcing policy changes may shift OEM supply strategies
bullets.summary: Policy-driven sourcing preferences may cause short-term supply frictions while incentivizing longer-term domestic capacity building; procurement strategies should reflect both horizons.

bullets.title: Scenario: Rapid battery storage deployment could change distribution-level operations
bullets.summary: Battery deployment at scale will interact with distribution protection and operations; coordination and standards will be required to avoid unintended stability consequences.
